title.zh: 字典序的第 K 小数字

desc.zh: 用十进制前缀的分层计数，推导整组跳过与向下寻找。
desc.en: Count decimal-prefix groups to derive when to skip a group or descend.

complexity: O((log n)^2) time; O(1) auxiliary space

concepts.name: Lexicographical prefix counting
concepts.description: Count a decimal-prefix group with clipped half-open intervals.

concepts.name: Lexicographical rank invariant
concepts.description: Maintain remaining moves when skipping a prefix group or descending.
